success_rules: Prefer actions that reduce the reported distance to the goal; keep useful headings while distance decreases.
Use short movement bursts and replan from fresh execution feedback instead of committing to a long open-loop route.
Use camera tilt only to inspect the scene; restore a useful forward view before translating when needed.
failure_models: If a movement fails because of a collision, rotate and try a different route rather than repeating the blocked action.
If distance increases after movement, reverse or change direction and use the previous lower-distance state as evidence.
